offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes in planned communities across the US, mainly to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers. Acquires land, builds the homes and sells them directly, with mortgage and title services offered through subsidiaries.

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title services; homebuyer insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time homebuyers, move-up buyers and active adults aged 55 and older

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of completed homes to buyers; interest or premiums: mortgage loans originated by its mortgage subsidiary and sold to investors

value_chain_position.value: service provider: builds homes on land it acquires, sold to individual homebuyers; financial intermediary: mortgage lending and title services for its own homebuyers

geography_served.value: US national: California, Texas, Florida, Arizona, Nevada, Colorado, Georgia, North Carolina, Virginia and other states

specialization.value: related lines: single-family detached homes, attached townhomes and active adult communities, with related mortgage and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling homes directly to buyers at its communities; own locations: model homes and on-site sales centers in its communities; online: website listing homes and community information for prospective buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, environmental, consumer protection and fair housing rules, mortgage subsidiary under federal and state lending laws
